listings.title: LEGO Bricks and Pieces Bulk Lot Mixed Themes 10 Pounds Bricks Parts & Figures
listings.summary: Purchased 10 lb mixed genuine LEGO lot with parts and figures. Raw item price was strong; cross-border shipping pushed the landed cost just above the nominal C$10/lb target.
listings.notes: Benchmark purchase. Diverse unsorted-looking composition makes it more attractive than the weight metric alone suggests.
listings.calculation: (C$66.29 item + C$41.65 shipping) / 10 lb = C$10.79/lb before tax.

listings.title: 15.6 lb vintage genuine LEGO bulk lot — no minifigures
listings.summary: Promising auction, but the displayed shipping figure was not confirmed for M6H 2W9.
listings.notes: Treat the C$6.08/lb figure as provisional until Toronto shipping is confirmed.
listings.calculation: (C$10.45 current bid + C$84.32 displayed shipping) / 15.6 lb = C$6.08/lb provisional.

listings.title: LEGO Bulk Lot 10 lb Mixed Bricks Plates Parts Random Assorted + Lego Storage
listings.summary: Strong 10 lb auction lead. Current bid is very low and the search result showed a C$49.14 shipping figure, but destination shipping to M6H 2W9 was not confirmed.
listings.notes: Do not treat the displayed C$49.14 shipping as resolved Toronto shipping. If that proxy happened to apply, current landed cost would be about C$6.64/lb and the proxy-implied maximum bid for C$10/lb would be C$50.86.
listings.calculation: At current bid, M6H 2W9 shipping can be as high as C$82.71 and still meet C$10/lb: (C$100 target total - C$17.29 bid).

listings.title: 10lbs Bulk LEGO Assorted Building Bricks
listings.summary: Very low current bid for a stated 10 lb bulk LEGO lot; destination shipping remains unresolved.
listings.notes: Potentially excellent if eBay International Shipping remains below the C$86.18 ceiling to M6H 2W9.
listings.calculation: At current bid, maximum shipping for C$10/lb is C$86.18: C$100 - C$13.82.

listings.title: Over 12 lbs Bulk Unsorted Lego Lot Various Themes With Minifigs!
listings.summary: Unsorted multi-theme lot with minifigures and more than 12 lb stated weight. Current bid still has room under the target if Toronto shipping is modest.
listings.notes: Weight is described as over 12 lb; calculation conservatively uses exactly 12 lb. Destination shipping must be checked before bidding.
listings.calculation: Using 12 lb conservatively, target total is C$120; C$120 - C$69.17 current bid = C$50.83 maximum shipping for C$10/lb.

listings.title: 14+- LBS LEGO BULK LOT MIXED RANDOM LOOSE BRICKS PARTS PIECES BLOCKS BUILDING
listings.summary: Fourteen-pound-plus loose mixed LEGO lot with no bids yet and substantial room for destination shipping under the C$10/lb target.
listings.notes: Weight is described as 14+ lb; calculation conservatively uses 14 lb. Shipping to M6H 2W9 remains unresolved.
listings.calculation: Using 14 lb conservatively, target total is C$140; C$140 - C$41.49 = C$98.51 maximum shipping for C$10/lb.

listings.title: Lego 16 Lbs Pounds Box of Legos Bricks Pieces Parts Mixed Bulk Lot
listings.summary: Sixteen-pound mixed LEGO auction with a current bid low enough to leave substantial shipping headroom.
listings.notes: Destination shipping to M6H 2W9 remains unresolved; verify before bidding.
listings.calculation: Target total for 16 lb at C$10/lb is C$160; C$160 - C$69.16 = C$90.84 maximum shipping.
